summary: The EXPLORE Data Science Academy (EDSA) is a premier data science academy in South Africa that offers students an intensive one-year training course and provides a fundamental understanding of software development and cloud computing technologies. In this episode, Simon speaks with Clive Charlton (Head of Solution Architecture at AWS) and Shaun Dippnall (CEO & Co-founder of EDSA) about how the academy gives students a competitive edge, and teaches them how to solve real-world problems using the latest emerging data science technologies. Learn more about the AWS Africa Region- https://go.aws/3Jx2HUz Visit the EDSA website: https://explore-datascience.net/
title: #498: [African Stories #2] EXPLORE Data Science Academy

summary: Does your team use feature flags or other dynamic configuration to update your software's behavior during application runtime? In this episode, Simon Elisha speaks with Steve Rice (Principal Product Manager, AWS), Brian Handy (Sr. Software Engineer, AWS), and Vinni Sagar (Technical Product Manager, AWS) about feature flags, Continuous Configuration, and AWS AppConfig. Learn why feature flags are so powerful, and hear how customers (as well as thousands of teams inside Amazon) leverage dynamic configuration to make software changes safely. About AWS AppConfig - https://go.aws/3FQNpqE Continuous Configuration blog post by Amazon CTO Werner Vogels - https://bit.ly/3Kzpvnq AWS AppConfig Feature Flags blog post - https://go.aws/32oyTsM
title: #501: Using AWS AppConfig
